new_processes.name: EOL deal change controls
new_processes.definition: Enforcing and explaining the rule that EOL deals and their Sitara tickets must not be changed, and communicating and handling changes to EOL deals made by counterparties.

new_processes.name: Counterparty existing-deal lookup
new_processes.definition: Querying the deal systems for existing transactions with named counterparty entities and reporting the results to the requester.

new_processes.name: Transaction flow document review
new_processes.definition: Reviewing and editing the draft transaction flow process document with named reviewers and consolidating their changes.

new_processes.name: Reorganization options review
new_processes.definition: Collecting revisions on reorganization option notes ahead of a management meeting.
